payload.reason: The evidence provides comparative performance results of the proposed text smoothing method against various baseline data augmentation methods, indicating significant improvements in accuracy across multiple datasets.

claims.text: Text smoothing outperforms the previously best method, BARTspan, by 1.17% in average accuracy.
Text smoothing significantly improves baseline methods such as EDA, BackTrans, and others by margins ranging from 2.17% to 6.48%.
In low-resource settings, text smoothing achieves better performance than various mainstream data augmentation methods.
